articles.summary: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, an Apache 2.0 agentic coding model post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B with reinforcement learning only. articles.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth new Gemini model in a month
articles.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a new frontier model built for software development, knowledge work, and science. It handles text, images, video, audio, and PDFs with a context window of one million tokens. At $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, Neon is priced above previous Gemini 4 models.
